title: Workspace manifest
description: The manifest at <user-project>/graphcompose-flow/flow.config.json. Its presence is what marks a directory as a GraphCompose AI Flow workspace: the tools walk up from the current directory looking for it, so a user standing anywhere inside their Java project gets the right projects and templates. Everything in it is optional except the contract version — the manifest pins choices, it does not carry state.

schemaVersion.description: On-disk contract version for the workspace manifest.

graphComposeVersion.description: GraphCompose version this workspace targets. Written when the pin should not be re-derived from the host project's build file — otherwise scripts/resolve-version.mjs reads pom.xml / build.gradle(.kts) and this stays absent.

skillPack.description: Skill pack the projects here author against, relative to the harness install root. Normally derived from graphComposeVersion; pinned explicitly only to hold a pack across a version bump.

hostProject.description: Path to the Java project this workspace serves, relative to the workspace directory. Defaults to the parent directory, which is where the build file usually is.

projects.description: Optional index of the project ids under projects/. The directory listing is authoritative; this exists so a workspace can declare an intended order.

notes.description: Free-form note for whoever opens this workspace next.
